items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I can remember bands like the New Orleans Rhythm Kings on records, and the Halfway House Orchestra, Johnny Byersdorfer.

ctx.x: Sure. What about early dance bands? Can you remember the very first dance music?

I can remember bands like the Owls. Of course, I was a little boy, and I wasn't able to go to the dance, but I can remember hearing records. And then it was the early days of radio. I can remember I had a little crystal set, and I used to sit down and tune in. And of course, I was looking for the music, and nothing else interested me. I wanted to hear the music. There were some good bands, and I think... Oh, no, let me see. I mentioned the Owls. I don't know. I can't remember the others. But I can remember bands…
Who was in Classy's band, by the way?
